assets.prompt: Create a production website BACKGROUND PLATE, a new standalone landscape illustration styled to match the supplied Mega XO website reference. Output a wide 16:9 high resolution image. Absolutely NO TEXT, letters, numbers, logos, user interface, tic tac toe marks, board, icons, buttons, badges, people or devices. Just an atmospheric cinematic alien mountain valley at night. Near-black navy sky occupying top 55 percent, very subtle sparse blue stars. Left and right jagged rocky mountain silhouettes framing a receding valley, cobalt illuminated rock edges. A luminous blue horizon and purple mist along the bottom 35 percent, streaks of cyan light running gently through the rocky valley floor; darker foreground. Keep center and upper left extremely dark with restrained detail so bright website text remains readable. Purple glow toward left, cobalt blue glow toward right, a tiny violet planet low behind right ridges. Premium polished fantasy esports artwork, photoreal painterly 3D rendered rocks, not cartoon. Match reference colors #030917 #06122c #103982 #34216c, tasteful light emission. Preserve exact mood/composition of reference mountainous background but remove all foreground site elements. This is supporting artwork, not an edit target. Save the image as a project asset.
assets.role: Clean mountain/starfield background; no UI baked into plate
assets.fallback: Static WebP; CSS responsive crop; no motion/video required to render

assets.prompt: Supporting production website illustration. Output genuine transparent background cutout and do not bake black backdrop. One trophy isolated, near square aspect.

A single premium blue and violet crystal esports rank emblem, as close as possible to the decorative diamond rank crest in the right-hand panel of the provided reference website image. Transparent background, full emblem centered and isolated with margin, no text, no UI, no numbers, no other objects. Symmetric angular silver-blue wings on left and right, layered beveled blue shield frame shaped like a long diamond pointing down, a faceted glowing violet blue diamond gemstone in the very center, smaller pointed icy blue spire above. Strong cyan beveled edges, indigo shadows, luminous violet core, cinematic polished photoreal 3D videogame badge. Front-on orthographic view. Crisp exact geometric silhouette, high-detail metallic bevels, jewel facets and restrained glow. This is only a decorative illustrative emblem, not an alternate game rank or new product tier. Genuine alpha-transparent PNG cutout.
assets.role: Decorative crystal emblem; does not identify a guest as Diamond or create a subdivision
